confirmDelete: Delete this jigsaw for good? Its picture and all its rounds, also other players', are deleted too.
nobody: Nobody has played this jigsaw yet.
couldNotDelete: Could not delete the jigsaw: only its owner can.
couldNotStart: Could not start a round: try again.
couldNotDeleteRound: Could not delete the round: try again.
privateForPlayers: Private: only its owner and its players see it
hiddenNote: Hidden: only in your list of jigsaws
fixedNote: The picture, the size, the pieces and the difficulty are fixed, since rounds of this jigsaw have been started.
resetRounds: Delete all rounds to change them
resetAsk: Delete all the rounds of this jigsaw for good, also other players’? Then the picture, the size and the difficulty can be changed.
couldNotResetRounds: Could not take away the rounds: only its owner can.
roundProtected: Locked: started with a sign-in of this account
startTitle: Choose the pieces and the difficulty
choosePieces: You choose the pieces and the difficulty when you start a round
snapHelp: How close a piece must be to its place before it snaps in. Easy: from far away. Hard: only right next to it.
roundWhoHelp: Public: the round is in the list of rounds on the front page. Private: only you see it.
